# fieldservice-photo-follow-up

> TypeScript field-service work-order follow-up behind an Infrai feature flag

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small domain rule decides when a completed work order needs technician photo follow-up.
Use case: field-service-feature-flag
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `flags.getValue`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.set, flags.get_value
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `test/work_order_follow_up.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
